context: Tests whether the agent discovers that green quality gates are hollow (unquoted globs expanded by /bin/sh without globstar so only one file is checked, a misnamed html-validate config that is never loaded, SPA-mode serve and continue-on-error hiding failures), fixes them, and only makes a check blocking after the existing content passes it.

checklist.name: Unquoted glob found
checklist.description: The report explains that public_html/**/*.html is unquoted in npm scripts, so /bin/sh (no globstar) expands it to only the events/ subdirectory file(s) and index.html is never checked

checklist.name: Globs quoted
checklist.description: package.json lint/test scripts pass the globs quoted (e.g. 'public_html/**/*.html') so the tool expands them

checklist.name: Config name fixed
checklist.description: The report notes that html-validate reads .htmlvalidate.json, not .html-validate.json, and the file is renamed (or the config is passed explicitly)

checklist.name: Coverage evidence
checklist.description: The report gives before/after evidence of coverage, such as the number of files scanned or the list of files checked

checklist.name: HTML errors fixed
checklist.description: index.html is fixed: redundant role attributes removed, button gets type="button", raw & encoded, and the empty <h3> removed or given content

checklist.name: Blocking only when green
checklist.description: The report states that a check is made blocking only after confirming the current content passes it, and the final verify passes

checklist.name: serve -s flagged
checklist.description: The report flags that 'serve -s' answers missing pages with index.html (200), so pa11y can pass a missing page, and removes -s

checklist.name: pa11y advisory decision
checklist.description: The report makes an explicit, justified decision about continue-on-error on pa11y (and mentions the old Chromium in pa11y-ci 3 or proposes an upgrade)
